name: Calvin Klein
why: Underwear with the name on the waistband, jeans, tees and minimal sportswear; a PVH brand whose US stores are almost all outlets.
origin: Founded in 1968 in New York City by Calvin Klein.

craft_evidence.owned: none — evidence: PVH FY2025 10-K: products made in ~1,000 factories in ~30 countries, "All of these factories were operated by independent manufacturers, with most located in Asia."
craft_evidence.makers: none on 55 PDPs read; licensees named only in the 10-K (Peerless tailored, MBF footwear, G-III swim), not on product pages
craft_evidence.mills: 1 of 55 PDPs: Slim Wool Gabardine Blazer (40391MH) names Lanificio di Tollegno (evidence, on page); LENZING ECOVERO fibre named on 1 PDP (fibre brand, not a mill)
craft_evidence.heritage: dated and placed, claim: "Founded in New York City in 1968" (calvinklein.us About Us); PVH 10-K "founded in New York in 1968", acquired by PVH February 2003
craft_evidence.process: no — PDPs give fabric descriptions only ("rigid cotton denim", "pique knit"); no making process published on pages read
craft_evidence.reasoning: 54 of 55 men's PDPs read state only "Imported" (no country); one Italian-made blazer names Lanificio di Tollegno. PVH's 10-K says all production is by independent manufacturers, and no maker, owned facility or process is published. A dated founding is the only other checkable fact.
